title: Palo Alto Networks Profit Outlook Tops Estimates, Margins Narrow
description: The cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks Inc. issued a profit outlook for the year that exceeded Wall Street’s expectations, fueled by corporate demand for stronger defenses against advancing artificial intelligence systems.

title: Stocks Slide as Oil Surges & Treasury Yields Rise | The Close 9/1/2026
description: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Dimensional Fund Advisors Founder & Chairman David Booth, T. Rowe Price CEO Rob Sharps, Christian & Timbers Founder & CEO Jeff Christian, New York Life Investment Management Global Market Strategist Julia Hermann, Founder ETFs Partner & Portfolio Manager Michael Monaghan, Evercore Equity Analyst Peter Levine, KIND Snacks Founder Daniel Lubetzky, & ValueEdge Advisors Chair Nell Minow. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: NYLIM's Hermann Says Bond Market Signals Tighter Rates
description: Julia Hermann, Global Market Strategist at New York Life Investment Management, says the recent move in bonds is warning equity investors to pay closer attention to interest rates. In her view, markets are heading into a tighter rates environment over the next few months, but the key question is whether the pressure comes from the front end of the curve through an imminent Fed tightening cycle or from the long end through further Treasury selloff and higher long-term yields. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
